dec.pe: A Turkish worker in Austria who had paid into the system was refused emergency benefits because he was not Austrian. The European Court said this was discrimination.
dec.pi: Seorang pekerja Turki di Austria yang sudah membayar iuran ditolak tunjangan darurat karena bukan warga Austria. Mahkamah Eropa menyatakan ini diskriminasi.

dec.pe: Filipino domestic workers said they had been exploited abroad and then in Vienna, where they escaped. Austria protected them but did not prosecute. The Court said Austria had done enough.
dec.pi: Pekerja rumah tangga Filipina mengaku dieksploitasi di luar negeri lalu di Wina, tempat mereka melarikan diri. Austria melindungi mereka tetapi tidak menuntut. Mahkamah menyatakan Austria sudah cukup bertindak.
